description: This file implements the MediaKeysCapabilities class and related functions for managing media key system support, including querying supported key systems, checking support for specific key systems, and retrieving version information. It also includes factory methods for creating instances of these classes and a utility function for converting error statuses to strings.

classes.name: MediaKeysCapabilities
classes.description: Implements media key system support querying, including supported key systems, support checks, and version retrieval.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystems
methods.description: Returns a list of supported key system identifiers.

methods.name: supportsKeySystem
methods.description: Checks if a specific key system is supported.

methods.name: getSupportedKeySystemVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version of a specific key system.
